caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a dark reddish-brown hue, modeled in a three-quarter view that displays both its side and front. The chair’s design features a rounded backrest that curves into the armrests, which are adorned with two prominent spiral scroll details. The backrest is solid with a decorative silhouette cut and the seat appears to be made of woven cane material. The chair has four cabriole legs that curve outward at the bottom, connected by three sets of stretchers for stability. In the upper left corner of the drawing is a small inset line sketch of the same chair, annotated with dimensions (14 and 19, presumably inches), and drawn in the same reddish-brown color as the chair in the main image. The entire composition is enclosed within a large, rectangular border. At the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten signature and the date 1861, as well as additional text. The background is a plain, pale color, emphasizing the shape and details of the chair.
title: Empire Chair
